sites.name: Langbiang Mountain
sites.event: Associated with the tragic love story of K'lang and H'biang, known as the 'Roof of Da Lat'.

sites.name: Da Lat Railway Station
sites.event: The oldest remaining railway station in Indochina, famous for its unique architecture featuring three pyramidal roofs mimicking Langbiang Mountain and a cog railway.

sites.name: Bao Dai Palace III (Head of State Palace)
sites.event: The residence and workplace of King Bao Dai (the last king of the Nguyen Dynasty) and his family in Da Lat.

sites.name: Tuyen Lam Lake
sites.event: The largest freshwater lake in Da Lat, recognized as a National Tourist Area, where Truc Lam Zen Monastery is located.

sites.name: Pongour Waterfall (Seven-Tiered Waterfall)
sites.event: Known as the 'First Waterfall of the Southern Sky', associated with the legend of the female chief Kanai and four rhinoceroses.

sites.name: Da Lat Teacher's College (Grand Lycee Yersin)
sites.event: A unique French architectural work recognized by the International Union of Architects (UIA) as one of the 1,000 outstanding works of the 20th century.

sites.name: Linh Quy Phap An Pagoda
sites.event: Famous for the 'Heaven's Gate' amidst a sea of clouds, likened to a fairyland.

sites.name: Dambri Waterfall
sites.event: The most majestic waterfall in the Bao Loc region, associated with the legend of the faithful love between a K'ho couple (Dam and H'bi).

sites.name: Bidoup - Nui Ba National Park
sites.event: Langbiang World Biosphere Reserve, home to Bidoup Peak, the highest peak in Lam Dong Province (2,287m).

sites.name: Xuan Huong Lake
sites.event: A green gem in the heart of the city, recognized as the first National Scenic Monument of Lam Dong.

sites.name: Datanla Waterfall
sites.event: Associated with the legend of the warrior K'Lang fighting wild beasts, famous for its alpine coaster system through the forest.

sites.name: Truc Lam Da Lat Zen Monastery
sites.event: One of the three largest Zen monasteries in Vietnam of the Truc Lam Yen Tu sect, located on Phung Hoang Mountain.
